boundaries.name: imported-parser-guards
boundaries.obligation: The per-field guards (ChannelId 32-bit and nonzero, BlockNumber < 2^63, U64 and Bytes32 32-bit limbs, PoseidonHashOut exact length with no canonical-field check) are transcribed by hand from src/common and src/ethereum_types; no refinement links them to those files.

boundaries.name: gadget-range-check-lowering
boundaries.obligation: AllocationChecks assumes the imported range_check / U32 limb / Poseidon target constructors constrain wires to the stated widths when is_checked is true; the plonky2 gate lowering and the unchecked (is_checked = false) path are not proved.

boundaries.name: hash-binding-and-canonical-field
boundaries.obligation: Poseidon hash_inputs_u64 / hash_inputs are opaque callbacks; concrete_commitment_binding assumes binding for a single compared pair only. Full-input words are not checked to be canonical field elements; ToField::to_field_vec may panic and is a caller callback.

boundaries.name: verifier-data-representation
boundaries.obligation: VerifierOnlyCircuitData / VerifierCircuitTarget are modelled as a digest plus cap-root list; vd_to_vec, vd_from_pis_slice and their target versions in utils/cyclic.rs are re-modelled by hand, including the index panic on short native caps and the silent ignoring of extra cap roots.

boundaries.name: native-and-target-refinement
boundaries.obligation: Nat stands for both u64 words and field wires; Rust asserts, .expect panics, witness-write failures, serde and error-message formatting, and the equivalence of emitted targets to the native parse are not refined from the source.

boundaries.name: caller-invariants
boundaries.obligation: Neither parser enforces block_r <= public_state.block_number, the target parser accepts arbitrary suffix words and does not reject channel 0, and the settled_tx_chain fold, private-state ownership and genesis root correctness are obligations of the calling circuits, not of this file.
